description: `platformAutomerge` hands the merge of an automerging PR to GitHub's native auto-merge, which lands it the moment the Protect Main ruleset's required checks (Bazel rules validation, Analysis tests, Android aspect and External Compose consumer, per yschimke/renovate-config repo-policy) pass, instead of on Renovate's next run. Safe because those checks build and test; native auto-merge waits only on required checks.
